messages:
deploybot: PROD deploy initiated by sophia — env=prod region=eu-west-1 commit=9f8e7d6c tag=release/v3.6.0-alpha. beginning phased rollout: canary-1 -> canary-2 -> full.

sophia: Starting the window; pinned tag in release dashboard. Ops alerted.

taylor: I'll run the user-facing sanity checks and verify token accounting endpoints.

risk-bot: Quick policy check: new runtime flags enabled (kv_cache_eviction=true, batch_optimizer=aggressive). No blocked flags.

deploybot: Canary 1 deployed: health=OK, instance_count=4. Serving sample traffic.

risk-bot: Initial security scan passed (no new risky deps).

 taylor: Observing a 2x spike in db connection churn on one host. I'm pausing ramp and investigating.

sophia: Hold traffic, thanks taylor. rollback threshold: connection errors >1% or 5xx >0.3% for 10m.

sre-oncall: Looking into connection churn, checking connection pool configs and recent infra changes.

taylor: Found a misconfigured connection pool max in the service config for the new build. Patching now and restarting pods.

sre-oncall: Pod restart complete, DB connections stabilized.

 deploybot: Canary 1 rechecked: health=OK. Resuming ramp to canary-2 at 25%.

 sophia: Proceed cautiously; we'll hold at 50% for 8 minutes to monitor latency percentiles.

 deploybot: Canary 2 in progress.

 risk-bot: Telemetry snapshot: p50=28ms p95=120ms p99=410ms errors=0.04%. No alerts.

 taylor: p99 tail is a bit higher than baseline but within the tolerable regression window. Proceeding.

 deploybot: Rolling to 100% over 5 minutes.

 deploybot: PROD deploy complete. commit=9f8e7d6c tag=release/v3.6.0-alpha env=prod region=eu-west-1 duration=00:14:44 :white_check_mark:

 sophia: Notes: alpha release enabling runtime flags for testing; not recommended for critical workloads. Changelog highlights: improved batching heuristics, fix for rare cache eviction causing duplication, tunable connection pool settings.

 taylor: I'll open a post-deploy checklist with the smoke logs. Keep an eye on p99 for 24h.

 sre-oncall: Monitoring active. Will escalate if unusual patterns emerge.

 sophia: Closing the rollout thread. Thanks all. :shipit:
